subject: Error when using the "satorra.bentler.2010" in lavTestLRT

messages.author: d5c7223b5e875974
messages.subject: Error when using the "satorra.bentler.2010" in lavTestLRT
parts:
Hello everyone,

After recently updating my lavaan package, I have noticed I keep getting this error when I try to use the "satorra.bentler.2010" method for comparing two nested models (with a negative scaling factor). The red text is the output I receive and the bolded text is my physical code. 

lavTestLRT(nodif.fit2.cor, nodif.fit4.cor, method="satorra.bentler.2010")
Error in colSums(S) : 'x' must be an array of at least two dimensions

When I try to do the same comparison just with the 'anova' function, the code runs without producing an error but still does not use the intended satorra.bentler.2010 approach to compare models (see below). 

anova(nodif.fit2.cor,  nodif.fit4.cor,  method = "satorra.bentler.2010")

Scaled Chi-Squared Difference Test (method = “satorra.bentler.2001”)

lavaan NOTE:
    The “Chisq” column contains standard test statistics, not the
    robust test that should be reported per model. A robust difference
    test is a function of two standard (not robust) statistics.
 
                                  Df   AIC   BIC  Chisq Chisq diff Df diff Pr(>Chisq)
nodif.fit4.cor 262 69945 70803 1640.4                              
nodif.fit2.cor 264 69697 70545 1397.1    -587.99       2          1

I also tried to use the semTools compareFit function and ran into the same problem as with the lavTestLRT(). Of note, I am estimating both models with "MLR" and they are the same model, except the model with more DFs has two additional correlations between 2 factors. Any insights would be greatly appreciated! 


Best wishes,
Allie
